thesis: The speaker recounts his career transition from traditional finance at bulge bracket banks to seeking autonomy in family offices and hedge funds, which led him to interview for a sales role at Second Market. During that interview, the founder Barry Silver convinced him that Bitcoin would change the world, prompting the speaker to pursue a career in the digital currency space.
